_meta.format: F1 deterministic dative-object frame bank; F3 anchors may reuse attested jemandem/dem Programm errors
_meta.validation_notes: Standard German. Every blank includes a nominative citation-form cue in parentheses and has one inflected dative answer. The bank distinguishes true dative objects from prepositional phrases; later entries include common ditransitives whose recipient is dative.
